Frequently asked questions

Answers to the questions we hear most often. Talk to our team for a quote tailored to your site.

How do I choose the right solar system size?

The right size depends on your electricity use, available roof space and future needs. Share your electricity bills with us, and we will recommend the suitable system after a site survey.

What is the difference between on-grid, off-grid and hybrid solar?
  • On-grid: Connected to the electricity grid; usually does not provide backup during power cuts.
  • Off-grid: Works independently with batteries; suitable for areas without reliable grid power.
  • Hybrid: Combines solar, grid power and batteries to provide savings and backup.
Does an on-grid solar system work during a power cut?

No. A standard on-grid system automatically shuts down during a power cut for safety. A hybrid system with batteries is required for backup.

What is net metering?

Net metering allows surplus solar power to be exported to the grid. The exported electricity is adjusted against the power you consume from the grid, helping reduce your electricity bill.

What is PM Surya Ghar, and who can benefit from it?

PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana is a government scheme that supports eligible residential households in installing rooftop solar. Individual homes and eligible housing societies or RWAs can benefit, subject to government and DISCOM rules.

How much subsidy is available under PM Surya Ghar?

Eligible residential consumers can receive:

  • 1 kW: ₹30,000
  • 2 kW: ₹60,000
  • 3 kW or more: ₹78,000 (maximum)

The final subsidy is subject to scheme conditions, approved installation and DISCOM verification.

How long does the PM Surya Ghar subsidy take to credit?

The subsidy is usually credited directly to your bank account within 30 working days after DISCOM inspection, commissioning and submission of correct bank details. You can track the status on the PM Surya Ghar portal.

Does SwayamUrja provide Solar EPC for residential, commercial and industrial projects?

Yes. SwayamUrja provides end-to-end solar EPC solutions for residential, commercial and industrial projects, including design, installation, commissioning and project support.

Does SwayamUrja provide BESS and renewable energy integration solutions?

Yes. We provide energy-storage and renewable-energy integration solutions, including BESS, solar-plus-storage, wind-solar hybrid and EV-infrastructure solutions, based on your requirements.

Does SwayamUrja provide Solar O&M and AMC services?

Yes. We provide solar O&M and AMC services, including system inspections, panel cleaning, performance monitoring, preventive maintenance and breakdown support.

How can I request a quotation or solar site survey from SwayamUrja?

Contact us through our website, phone or email and share your location, electricity bill and project details. Our team will arrange a site survey and provide a customised technical and commercial quotation.
